name: pii-shield-fr
description: Anonymize PII in documents. Requires a one-time model install (in-chat install panel, see README). Pure Node.js, no Python dependency.
long_description: MCP server that anonymizes documents before Claude sees them and restores real data after analysis. PII never enters the API — only file paths and session IDs are exchanged. Uses GLiNER zero-shot NER via ONNX Runtime for high-quality entity recognition in legal documents, with Human-in-the-Loop review via an in-chat MCP Apps panel (no browser required). Supports PDF, DOCX (with tracked changes / redline), and plain text. Includes 17 EU pattern recognizers, entity deduplication, chunked processing for large documents, and full local audit logging. The GLiNER model (~935 MB, 892 MiB) is installed separately: the in-chat install panel installs the zip from the release, or `install-model.ps1` downloads it from Hugging Face. This keeps the plugin tiny (<2 MB, instant install in Claude Desktop) and decouples model updates from code. First-run also installs native npm deps (onnxruntime-node + transformers, ~1–2 min). Pure Node.js, no Python dependency.

tools.name: find_file
tools.description: Find a file on the host by filename. Searches the configured working directory only.

tools.name: anonymize_file
tools.description: Anonymize PII in a file (.pdf, .docx, .txt, .md, .csv). PREFERRED — PII stays on host. Pass review_session_id for HITL re-anonymization.

tools.name: deanonymize_text
tools.description: Restore PII to local file (never returns PII to Claude)

tools.name: deanonymize_docx
tools.description: Restore PII in .docx preserving formatting (file only)

tools.name: get_mapping
tools.description: Get placeholder keys and types (no real PII values)

tools.name: list_entities
tools.description: Show status, supported types, and recent sessions

tools.name: start_review
tools.description: Open the HITL review panel in the chat (MCP Apps iframe). PII stays on your machine — decisions travel back via apply_review_overrides.

tools.name: apply_review_overrides
tools.description: Apply the user's review decisions (remove false positives, add missed entities). Called by the review panel when the user clicks Approve.

tools.name: start_model_setup
tools.description: Open the in-chat install panel for the GLiNER model (MCP Apps iframe). Two buttons: Download (host opens release URL in browser, browser handles 935 MB transfer) and Install (server auto-detects ZIP in Downloads / OneDrive / Desktop / etc., extracts into ~/.pii_shield/models/). Call when list_entities returns phase: 'needs_setup'.

tools.name: install_model_from_download
tools.description: Server tool called by the setup panel after the user downloads gliner_multi_pii-v1.zip. Finds the ZIP via 3-tier search (candidate dirs / marker BFS / configured folder), validates, atomic-extracts, re-inits NER.

tools.name: anonymize_next_chunk
tools.description: Process next chunk of a chunked anonymization session.

tools.name: get_full_anonymized_text
tools.description: Assemble all processed chunks and finalize the anonymization.

tools.name: resolve_path
tools.description: Zero-config file path resolution via marker file BFS.

tools.name: apply_tracked_changes
tools.description: Apply tracked changes (redline) to a .docx file with Word-native revision marks.

pii_min_score.title: Minimum pattern score
pii_min_score.description: Minimum confidence threshold for pattern recognizers (0.0-1.0). Lower = more recall, more false positives. Default 0.30 matches the tuned sweet spot for legal documents.

ner_threshold.title: NER threshold
ner_threshold.description: Minimum confidence threshold for GLiNER NER model (0.0-1.0). Lower = more recall, more noise (generic words like 'account', 'banks' slip through). Default 0.30 cuts most noise while retaining real corporate names.

work_dir.title: Working directory
work_dir.description: Folder path where your documents are stored. Used by find_file and anonymize_file for automatic path resolution.

skip_review.title: Skip HITL review
skip_review.description: Set to 'true' to skip the human review step after anonymization.

mask_courts.title: Mask court names
mask_courts.description: Set to 'true' to mask French court names (Tribunal de commerce, Cour d'appel, Conseil de prud'hommes...). Default 'false': the court name stays visible, only the city that follows is masked.

models_path.title: GLiNER model directory (optional)
models_path.description: Folder containing gliner_multi_pii-v1/ (the model + 4 tokenizer files). Leave empty to auto-detect in ~/.pii_shield/models/ (the default location used by install-model.ps1 / install-model.sh).

model_downloads_dir.title: Model downloads folder (rare override)
model_downloads_dir.description: Folder to scan for gliner_multi_pii-v1.zip (the install panel's auto-detect). Leave empty unless your browser saves files somewhere unusual — by default the install panel finds the ZIP in ~/Downloads, OneDrive variants, Desktop, Documents, the Windows Known Folder Downloads path, and the localized XDG Downloads on Linux.
